_comment: TTS at a FASTER speaking speed (length_scale 0.9). Same as config_tts.json but quicker narration. Output name carries the speed: tts_output/<base>.<voice>.s0.9.wav (the .s<scale> tag is added because length_scale != 1.0, so it won't collide with the normal-speed 1.0 file). Edit select_by/select to pick which text to voice.
